# Patterns for reusable-content-scan.yml.
# One ripgrep regex per line. `#` starts a comment. Blank lines ignored.
# When a review sweep finds new leaked content, add the pattern here so
# the next PR fails until it is removed.
#
# NOTE this file lives in THIS repo, not gh-workflows — the shared
# reusable ships no wordlist.
#
# Only GENERIC patterns live here: this repo is public, so a committed
# wordlist is world-readable. The private names (hostnames, codenames,
# the home-directory username, personal addresses) are in the repository
# Actions secret CONTENT_SCAN_PATTERNS (same format, one regex per line),
# passed to the reusable scan as secrets.patterns; findings from it are
# reported as path:line only.

# --- private LAN topology (RFC1918) ---
\b10\.10\.0\.
\b192\.168\.

# --- internal-jargon phrases ---
\baux fleet\b
\baux stack\b
# 2026-10-26: the swap-router phrase pattern was dropped. bench/pool_arm.sh reads the local
# router container's docker logs by its real name, so the phrase is part of the measurement,
# not a leak; main had been red on it since 2026-10-02.

# --- journal-voice phrases ---
\bfor tonight\b
\bnext[- ]session\b
\bstopping point\b
\bqueued next-session\b
